description.zh-CN: 在 RPEN 中导入/编辑/导出 Milthm 自制谱（fmt=2），轨道式。v0.7.1：模组启用后把 RPEN 文字字体换成随包分发的 ChillRoundF（第三方 OFL-1.1 字体，许可证与版权声明随包 fonts/OFL.txt + fonts/FONT-NOTICE.txt）——覆盖 RPE / RPEGame 两个字体族（界面、时间轴、预览文字全部生效）；可在设置里关闭。v0.7.0：RPEN 特殊事件（线文本/判定线贴图）导出时转成 Milthm 故事板。v0.6.9：修复预览旋转方向与渲染器相反。v0.6.8：预览落速按 Milthm 完整公式组合（Speed×线FlowSpeed×音符FlowSpeed）。v0.6.7：预览判定头放大到音符大小。v0.6.6：新增「全局流速（预览，同播放器 FLOW_SPEED）」设置（默认 1.66）。
description.en-US: Import/edit/export Milthm fan charts (fmt=2) in RPEN. Track-based: each judge line = one Milthm track, notes locked to track center. v0.7.1 replaces RPEN's text font with the bundled ChillRoundF font (third-party, SIL OFL-1.1; license text and copyright notice ship in fonts/OFL.txt and fonts/FONT-NOTICE.txt) while the mod is enabled, overriding the RPE / RPEGame font families (UI, timeline and preview text); it can be disabled in settings. v0.7.0 converts RPEN special events (line text / judgement-line textures) into Milthm storyboards on export. Export commands produce Milthm chart.json / package zip.

description.en-US: Same value and meaning as RainPlayerUnity global FLOW_SPEED: 1.66 matches the player default and the preview falling speed follows this number (player slider range 0.8-2.4). Preview only; chart data and export stay unchanged.

description.zh-CN: 启用时用随模组分发的 ChillRoundF.ttf 覆盖 RPEN 文字：界面/按钮/下拉/输入框等所有 DOM 文本，以及所有用 RPE / RPEGame 字体族的画布文本（时间轴、预览文字、编号等）都会换成这个字体；关闭后恢复 RPEN 自带字体。（ChillRoundF 是第三方 OFL-1.1 字体，不是 PhiEdit 自带字体；许可证与版权声明随包。）
description.en-US: Overrides RPEN text with the bundled ChillRoundF.ttf: all DOM text (buttons, selects, inputs, textareas, kbd, code boxes) and all canvas text that uses the RPE / RPEGame families (timeline, preview text, line numbers). Disable to restore RPEN's own font. (ChillRoundF is a third-party OFL-1.1 font, not PhiEdit's bundled font; license and copyright notice ship with the package.)
